defects: Specializes the general field 𝕜 (NontriviallyNormedField) and normed space E to the concrete case ℂ → ℂ, losing the generality of the gold statement

LHS '0 ≤ meromorphicOrderAt f x' (a comparison in WithTop ℤ that is trivially true when the order is ⊤, i.e. when f is locally identically zero) is replaced by '∃ n : ℤ, 0 ≤ n ∧ meromorphicOrderAt f x = ↑n', which forces the order to be a finite integer and excludes the ⊤ case; since the RHS (existence of an analytic extension) is still satisfiable in the ⊤ case (e.g. g = 0), this makes the produced iff false in that edge case, changing the mathematical content
